statement: Under partial participation, old-class argmax accuracy for a client that did not participate is lower when each client protects its own activation subspace than when every client uses one shared subspace of the same rank, with the same split, batches, participation, and the same float64 compact polar step.
not_a_method: The three arms are measurement conditions. No new optimizer, backfill, or constraint is proposed.
aggregation: One synchronous update from the round-start snapshot. X <- ((N-S)/N) X + (1/N) sum_{i in S} X_i, and C <- C + (1/N) sum_{i in S} (C_i_new - C_i_old). N is the client count and S is the participant count.
normalization: GroupNorm, so client batch-normalization statistics are not the measured mechanism
evaluation: argmax over all logits on the examples whose labels belong to the task; not logit-masked
contrast: shared minus client_specific, paired by seed
reject_if: The 95% bootstrap interval of the mean paired difference across seeds covers 0 or lies at or below 0.
existing_mlp_diagnostic_does_not_support: Seeds 0 and 1 of the corrected MLP diagnostic had worst-client old accuracy 0.065/0.056 for client-specific bases and 0.033/0.054 for the shared basis.
ns_role: Not the training step. One unnormalized Newton-Schulz step has spectral norm about 1.199, which does not satisfy ||D||_2 <= 1. The arms use the compact polar and divide by max(sigma, 1).
